fields.summary_ko.0: TD Cowen downgraded Marvell (MRVL) from 'buy' to 'hold' and cut the target price 50% to $175 (from $350).
fields.summary_ko.1: Following the Lumentum (LITE) acquisition announcement, MRVL fell 12% and LITE dropped 18.5% the previous day, with TD Cowen citing first-year earnings dilution concerns.
fields.summary_ko.2: MRVL has nearly doubled since early year and LITE has risen over 75%, raising questions about the timing of the acquisition deal.
